name: System X
goal: Therapeutic conversation, collaborative lyric writing, music generation and visualization, song revision, and reflective discussion.
description: A conversational system that helps Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing individuals express personal experiences through collaborative songwriting. It uses a language model to guide lyric writing and musical choices, a music generation model to create songs, and audio analysis tools to visualize music and support emotional reflection. Actors: model_1 = language model; model_2 = music generation model; tool_1 = step completion checker; tool_2 = music analysis API; tool_3 = sequence alignment algorithm; tool_4 = beat analysis library; tool_5 = visual rendering tool.

processes.name: Therapeutic conversation
processes.description: At the start of a session, model_1 asks supportive questions about the user's experiences, emotions, motivation, and musical preferences. It extracts required information from the conversation, while a tool_1 determines when to advance to the next step. This repeats until the required information for each step is collected.
processes.rawExpression:
(therapy_framework_1: instruction record) + (chat_history_1: artifact language)
-> [model_1 extract]
-> (therapy_framework_1: instruction record) + (chat_history_1: artifact language) + (required_variables_1: artifact record)
-> [tool_1 evaluate]
-> (therapy_framework_1: instruction record) + (chat_history_1: artifact language) + (required_variables_1: artifact record) + (step_status_1: evaluation categorical)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (therapy_framework_1: instruction record) + (chat_history_1: artifact language) + (question_1: artifact language)
-> [human specify]
-> (therapy_framework_1: instruction record) + (chat_history_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Collaborative lyric writing
processes.description: After discussing personal experiences, the user develops a song concept and describes emotions, scenes, keywords, and lyric ideas in response to model_1's questions. model_1 uses these inputs to compose a complete song with verses, a chorus, and a bridge. The user reviews the lyrics and can request revisions until satisfied.
processes.rawExpression:
(chat_history_1: artifact language) + (required_variables_1: artifact record)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (lyric_questions_1: artifact language)
-> [human specify]
-> (lyric_inputs_1: artifact language)
-> [model_1 extract]
-> (song_concept_1: instruction record) + (lyric_elements_1: artifact record)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language)
-> [human evaluate]
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (lyrics_feedback_1: evaluation language)
-> [model_1 modify]~
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Music generation and visualization
processes.description: After the lyrics are ready, model_1 helps the user choose musical attributes and converts them into a style prompt for model_2, which generates a vocal track. tool_2 extracts musical features and word timings, a sequence alignment algorithm synchronizes the timings with the actual lyrics, and tool_4 extracts beats. The system then renders animated lyrics and beat visualizations alongside the generated music.
processes.rawExpression:
(lyrics_1: artifact language) + (song_concept_1: instruction record)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (music_guidance_1: artifact language)
-> [human specify]
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (music_attributes_1: instruction record)
-> [model_1 translate]~
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (style_prompt_1: instruction language)
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (song_1: artifact audio)
-> [tool_2 extract]
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (song_1: artifact audio) + (predicted_transcript_1: artifact record) + (audio_features_1: artifact record)
-> [tool_3 match]
-> (song_1: artifact audio) + (timed_lyrics_1: artifact record) + (audio_features_1: artifact record)
-> [tool_4 extract]
-> (song_1: artifact audio) + (timed_lyrics_1: artifact record) + (audio_features_1: artifact record) + (beat_features_1: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_5 translate]
-> (song_1: artifact audio) + (music_visualization_1: artifact visual)

processes.name: Song discussion and reflection
processes.description: After the song is generated, model_1 asks whether the user is satisfied with it. If the user accepts the song, model_1 asks which lyrics or musical passages resonated with them and guides reflection on associated feelings, memories, and personal meaning. The user shares these reflections and receives supportive responses.
processes.rawExpression:
(song_1: artifact audio) + (music_visualization_1: artifact visual) + (lyrics_1: artifact language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (song_1: artifact audio) + (music_visualization_1: artifact visual) + (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (review_question_1: artifact language)
-> [human evaluate]
-> (song_1: artifact audio) + (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (song_feedback_1: evaluation language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (song_1: artifact audio) + (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (reflection_question_1: artifact language)
-> [human specify]
-> (reflection_1: artifact language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (supportive_response_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Music revision
processes.description: If the user requests changes after hearing the generated song, they can revisit their musical choices. The revised attributes are converted into a new style prompt, and model_2 generates another track using the lyrics. The new track is analyzed and visualized through the same music processing pipeline.
processes.rawExpression:
(song_1: artifact audio) + (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (music_attributes_1: instruction record) + (song_feedback_1: evaluation language)
-> [human modify]
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (music_attributes_2: instruction record)
-> [model_1 translate]~
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (style_prompt_2: instruction language)
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (song_2: artifact audio)
-> [tool_2 extract]
-> (lyrics_1: artifact language) + (song_2: artifact audio) + (predicted_transcript_2: artifact record) + (audio_features_2: artifact record)
-> [tool_3 match]
-> (song_2: artifact audio) + (timed_lyrics_2: artifact record) + (audio_features_2: artifact record)
-> [tool_4 extract]
-> (song_2: artifact audio) + (timed_lyrics_2: artifact record) + (audio_features_2: artifact record) + (beat_features_2: artifact tabular)
-> [tool_5 translate]
-> (song_2: artifact audio) + (music_visualization_2: artifact visual)

representations.therapy_framework: the steps of the therapy session and the information each step needs before moving on
representations.chat_history: the conversation so far between the user and the system
representations.required_variables: the information gathered from the conversation for the current step, such as experiences, emotions, motivation and musical preferences
representations.step_status: whether the current step has all its required information and the session can move on
representations.question: the next supportive question asked to the user
representations.lyric_questions: questions that help the user describe the song they want to write
representations.lyric_inputs: the user's answers: emotions, scenes, keywords and lyric ideas
representations.song_concept: the overall concept of the song
representations.lyric_elements: the emotions, scenes, keywords and lyric ideas taken from the user's answers
representations.lyrics: the song lyrics, with verses, a chorus and a bridge
representations.lyrics_feedback: the user's comments on the lyrics and requested changes
representations.music_guidance: explanations and suggestions that help the user choose musical attributes
representations.music_attributes: the chosen musical attributes, such as genre, mood, tempo and instruments
representations.style_prompt: a text style description for the music generation model
representations.predicted_transcript: the words recognized in the song, with timings
representations.audio_features: musical features analyzed from the song
representations.timed_lyrics: the actual lyrics aligned to the timings in the song
representations.beat_features: the beat times of the song
representations.music_visualization: animated lyrics and beat visuals shown while the song plays
representations.review_question: a question asking whether the user is satisfied with the song
representations.song_feedback: the user's reaction to the song
representations.reflection_question: a question about which lyrics or passages resonated and what feelings or memories they bring up
representations.reflection: the user's reflection on the song
representations.supportive_response: a supportive reply to the user's reflection
